cases.title: Explicit enterprise tenant and tenant boundary
cases.summary: Real Schema v7 SQLite storage rejected cross-tenant Space/KB visibility and inserts; official PostgreSQL Schema v7 DDL ENABLE/FORCE RLS binds tenant_id to app.current_org_id on every ks_v7_* table. Live PostgreSQL is executed in CI unit-suite/pytest-suite against a disposable non-superuser schema when KNOWLEDGE_SDK_TEST_PG_DSN is set. Not official final acceptance.

cases.title: Flat Tenant-Space-KB, no parent
cases.summary: Phase-1 model is flat Tenant -> Space -> KnowledgeBase on the real storage stack: no parent_space_id column, parent inserts are refused, and the PG DDL semantic checker rejects parent_space_id. Not formal tree-closure review.

cases.title: Same-org composite KB binding
cases.summary: One Space holds many KnowledgeBases; Space and KB share tenant_id; a cross-tenant or cross-space home rebind is refused on the real Schema v7 tables. Isolation-branch only.

cases.title: Detach not archive and same-home reattach
cases.summary: detach clears the mount and leaves archived=0; same-home reattach succeeds; attach to a different home fails; no implicit archive. Real storage, not formal acceptance.

cases.title: Employee personal owner boundary
cases.summary: Employee personal space is readable only by the owner; another same-tenant user is denied at the Space Gate (layer_2). Real storage, not formal acceptance.

cases.title: Enterprise admin no private-content shortcut
cases.summary: Enterprise admin cannot read employee personal body/content even when an extra grant row is planted; personal-private invariant holds. Real storage, not formal acceptance.

cases.title: Two same-tenant collaboration groups isolation
cases.summary: Two same-tenant team Spaces (collaboration groups) stay isolated: each owner can read only their own team KB. Real storage, not formal acceptance.

cases.title: Eight independent action grants
cases.summary: All eight official SPACE-C05 actions are granted and evaluated independently; revoking one action does not grant an unknown admin action. Real storage, not formal acceptance.

cases.title: Explicit Deny precedence
cases.summary: Explicit Deny on a KB or asset wins over owner, member, and agent profile; hydration of a denied target returns only an unavailable placeholder. Real storage, not formal acceptance.

cases.title: Agent Space ceiling
cases.summary: Agent allowed_space_ids is a hard ceiling: a user who can read another Space still cannot reach it through an agent that omits that Space. Real storage, not formal acceptance.

cases.title: KB fine-grained consumption scope
cases.summary: Agent fine-grained allowed_kb_ids tightens consumption: a KB outside the profile is denied even when the Space ceiling would allow it. Real storage, not formal acceptance.

cases.title: Knowledge-file scope
cases.summary: Knowledge-file scope is enforced via allowed_knowledge_file_ids; a file outside the list is denied. Real storage, not formal acceptance.

cases.title: Deliverable scope
cases.summary: Deliverable scope is enforced via allowed_deliverable_ids together with a current-user grant; a user without the underlying read cannot ride the agent. Real storage, not formal acceptance.

cases.title: Folder scope
cases.summary: Folder scope is enforced via allowed_folder_ids; a folder miss is denied. Real storage, not formal acceptance.

cases.title: Current User intersection and current profile
cases.summary: Effective authorization is User ∩ Agent ∩ current profile generation; a stale profile generation or an unauthorized user fails closed. Real storage, not formal acceptance.

cases.title: Transactional revocation/outbox rollback
cases.summary: Revoke + policy_generation bump + outbox insert commit atomically through the real store transaction; an injected failure rolls back grants, generation, and outbox together. Live PostgreSQL repeats this in CI. Not official final acceptance.

cases.title: Current policy generation strictness/staleness
cases.summary: Stale, non-integer, or out-of-range policy_generation values fail closed on the real Schema v7 engine. Not official final acceptance.

cases.title: Future HTTP independent-version compatibility
cases.summary: In-process HTTP surface keeps /v2/spaces frozen at 9940818b, serves a distinct /v7-core/spaces path, refuses silent v2 semantic changes, and refuses production /v3 mounts while EXPERIMENTAL_V3_ENABLED stays default false. Live signed /v2/spaces against a Schema v7 SQLite store runs when fastapi/uvicorn are available (CI unit-suite/pytest-suite). Not a formal HTTP compatibility gate.

cases.title: Future Python candidate protocol compatibility
cases.summary: Candidate Python protocol validators accept well-formed Space/KB/Favorite pointer payloads, reject parent_space_id and body-bearing favorites, and confirm frozen v21-reuse-v1 contract flags are unchanged. Not a formal independent Python client-compat gate.

cases.title: Future MCP candidate policy compatibility
cases.summary: Candidate MCP policy denies text-to-SQL / credential tools and any tool outside User ∩ Agent. Official MCP tool_definitions expose only the four evidence tools. Not formal MCP acceptance.

cases.title: External source missing assertion
cases.summary: A materialized external asset with no provider assertion, or a missing assertion record, is denied on the real storage engine. Isolation-branch only.

cases.title: External expired assertion
cases.summary: An expired external assertion (valid_until in the past) is denied even if a provider function returns a stale token. Real storage, not formal acceptance.

cases.title: External provider outage
cases.summary: A provider function that raises is treated as an outage and denied; no stale-allow fallback. Real storage, not formal acceptance.

cases.title: External revocation/tombstone/cursor
cases.summary: Revoked or tombstoned external refs are denied; a cursor mismatch fails closed; free text-to-SQL remains forbidden at the MCP policy layer. Real storage, not formal acceptance.

cases.title: Polymorphic favorite current-ACL hydration
cases.summary: Polymorphic favorite hydration stores only user_id+target pointers, never body/chunk/embedding/evidence, and hides denied metadata behind unavailable. Real storage, not formal acceptance.

cases.title: Future reviewed migration/rollback drill and security monotonicity
cases.summary: Owned-nonproduction v6->v7 upgrade is idempotent; rollback is idempotent, returns schema_version 6, and does not restore grants; restore of principal, grants, policy_generation, or shares is refused (monotonic). Production migration remains unauthorized. PG candidate DDL FORCE RLS semantics validate; CI runs the live PostgreSQL path on a disposable schema. Not a reviewed production migration drill.

cases.title: Personal-sharing/offboarding approval gating and full reviewed acceptance
cases.summary: Resign freezes within 0s (SLA 60s), starts 90-day read-only isolation retention, invalidates controlled shares immediately, forbids private-body auto-inherit, and requires two independent approvers for work-product handover. Real storage state machine only; not full reviewed formal acceptance.
